To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) German students living in the Netherlands are a highly mobile group of patients who travel home for treatment; (ii) distance and reimbursement issues are key factors in their health care seeking behaviour; (iii) the EU Directive is unlikely to affect the behaviour of this group; (iv) the findings call into questions whether the new EU Directive will affect the behaviour of Europeans in general.
